episodes.title: Related Companies: From Affordable Housing to Hudson Yards to AI Data Centers
episodes.headline: The Capital Company That Builds Neighborhoods
episodes.summary: How a firm founded in 1972 with a $10,000 loan to finance affordable housing became the developer of Hudson Yards, built a vertically integrated platform with its own fund manager, and closed a $16 billion financing for an AI data center, plus who Related works with and what to know before interviewing there.
episodes.interview_line: Related started as an affordable housing financier and became the developer of Hudson Yards. It's a capital company as much as a builder: it lines up anchor tenants and institutional partners first, which is why it can do 70 Hudson Yards and a $16 billion data center at the same time.
